Welcome

Imagine two weeks where every detail is curated and handled, every day is extraordinary, and every evening is shared with an incredible group of successful gay men exploring one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

Thailand is not simply a destination. It is a transformation. A place where ancient temples meet electric nightlife, where turquoise waters lap against limestone cliffs, and where the warmth of Thai culture opens something new in those who are truly present to receive it.

This is a curated life experience designed for men who appreciate the finer things and are ready to share them with an extraordinary group of people. Every hotel, every transfer, every experience has been handpicked with one goal: to give you the trip of a lifetime, without the stress of planning it.

A space where you can simply be yourself. No explanations needed.

Kevin Lee

Host & Trip Leader

As featured on NBC, CBS, FOX, and Chicago News, Kevin is a #1 international bestselling author, speaker, retreat leader, and healthcare professional with more than 30 years of experience helping people live fuller, more meaningful lives.

Kevin believes that the most memorable journeys are about more than the places we visit. They are about the people we meet, the experiences we share, and the friendships we bring home.

For nearly two decades, Kevin has brought people together through retreats, cruises, workshops, and transformational travel experiences around the world. Known for his warmth, compassion, and ability to create genuine connections, Kevin has a gift for turning groups of strangers into lifelong friends.

Thailand Adventure 2027 is more than a vacation. It is an opportunity to explore one of the world's most fascinating destinations alongside an incredible group of like-minded men, guided by a host whose passion is creating experiences people remember for a lifetime.

This isn't just a trip. It's an invitation. Travel Thailand with an incredible group of successful gay men while every detail is handled for you.

Raised on the French Riviera and fluent in both French and English, David has spent a lifetime exploring the world from Europe and Southeast Asia to Indonesia and destinations most people only dream about visiting.

Travel Insurance: Protect Your Investment

Life happens. A medical emergency, a family situation, or an unexpected event can arise at any time. With a non-refundable deposit and a trip of this value, travel insurance is not just a recommendation. It is peace of mind. A good policy can cover trip cancellation, medical emergencies abroad, travel delays, and lost baggage. Purchase your policy as soon as your deposit is made. Many plans only cover pre-existing medical conditions if you buy within 14 days of your first payment, so don't wait.

We suggest exploring these trusted options:

InsureMyTrip.com Compare dozens of plans side by side and find the best coverage for your specific situation and budget. Squaremouth.com Top-rated comparison site with verified customer reviews and zero bias toward any one provider. Allianz Travel Insurance One of the most trusted names in travel insurance with solid cancel-for-any-reason policy options.

⚠ Required Before You Fly

Entry Requirements: Thailand Digital Arrival Card

There is no visa fee for US citizens traveling to Thailand. You are granted up to 60 days on arrival at no charge. However, since May 2025, all travelers entering Thailand must complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) before departure. It takes about 10 minutes, it is completely free, and it gives you a QR code on your phone to breeze through immigration. Do not skip this step.

Step One 1

Visit the official site at tdac.immigration.go.th. This is the only legitimate free portal. Beware of scam sites that charge a fee.

Step Two 2

Complete the form within 72 hours before your flight. Fill out your passport details, travel itinerary, and health status exactly as they appear on your passport.

Step Three 3

You will receive a QR code by email. Show it at immigration alongside your passport. Pro tip: print a backup in case your phone battery dies.

Non-US passport holders should check entry requirements with their local Thai embassy well in advance. Each guest is responsible for ensuring their travel documents are valid.

Important — Please Note

International Airfare is Not Included

Guests are responsible for booking their own international flights to and from Bangkok. Fly into Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK). Private airport transfers to your hotel upon arrival are included in your package. Book your flights early. January is peak travel season to Thailand.

Depart By

January 24

The trip begins January 26 in Bangkok. Due to the long flight and time difference, you must depart your home city no later than January 24 to arrive on time.

Flight Duration

20–30+ Hours

There are no direct flights from the US to Bangkok. Expect one or two connections. Total travel time including layovers is typically 24–30+ hours depending on your departure city.

Time Difference

+12 Hours

Thailand is 12 hours ahead of Miami / Eastern Time. Plan accordingly for jet lag. Arriving January 24 or 25 gives you time to adjust before the adventure begins on January 26.

A Note on Luggage

For the smoothest experience, especially on our domestic transfers between cities, we recommend traveling with one checked bag and one carry-on. This keeps our group moving quickly and comfortably between Bangkok, Pattaya, and Phuket. And don't worry about running out of clean clothes. All three hotels offer next-day laundry service. Hand it in, get it back the following day. Pack smart and you will never feel like you are hauling your life across Thailand.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You
Need to Know

What airport do I fly into?

Fly into Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK) in Bangkok. This is Thailand's main international hub with direct and connecting flights from most major US cities. Private transfers from the airport to your hotel are included.

Do I need a visa?

US citizens do not need a visa and receive up to 60 days on arrival at no cost. You do need to complete the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) within 72 hours before your flight. See the entry requirements section above.

What is the weather like in late January?

Late January is one of the best times to visit Thailand. It is dry season. Sunny, warm, and low humidity. Expect temperatures in the low-to-mid 80s°F most days. Perfect beach and exploring weather throughout the entire trip.

Is this trip for all fitness levels?

Absolutely. This is a luxury experience, not a hiking expedition. Activities are designed to be enjoyable for everyone regardless of fitness level. If you have specific physical needs or limitations, simply let us know and we will accommodate you.

How do I pay my deposit?

All payments, deposits, and administrative matters are handled directly by David. Contact David at 1-954-651-0842 to get the process started. A $2,000 deposit per person secures your spot. David will walk you through payment options and next steps. Space is strictly limited so reach out as soon as you are ready.

What is the group like?

This is an intimate group of 16 gay men who appreciate the finer things, value real connection, and want more than a standard tourist experience. Kevin personally curates the group dynamic to ensure everyone feels comfortable, included, and genuinely welcomed from day one.

Can I room with a friend?

Yes. If you are booking with a friend, select the Double Occupancy rate and you will share a room. If you prefer your own private room, select Single Occupancy. Let us know your preference when you register.

Are there any pre-trip meetings?

Yes. Kevin hosts live Zoom info sessions where you can meet other guests, ask questions, and get a feel for what this adventure will be like. Contact Kevin to find out about upcoming session dates.

What is not included?

International airfare to and from Bangkok, alcoholic beverages, personal shopping, meals on free days, travel insurance, and visa fees for non-US passport holders are not included. Everything else is handled.

Do the hotels have laundry service?

Yes, all three hotels offer laundry service. Simply hand your laundry in and you will have it back the next day. Please note that laundry service is available at an additional fee. This means you do not need to overpack. A well-organized carry-on and one checked bag is genuinely all you need for the entire 13 nights. Pack light and let the hotels handle the rest.

Do you have a referral program?

Yes. Know someone who would love this trip? Ask about our Referral and Ambassador Reward Program. You can earn rewards for every guest you send our way. Contact Kevin or David for details.
